selectionMeaning: The owner considers A promising and requests a materially more commercial, premium, top-tier aesthetic direction. This authorizes concept refinement, not production implementation.
taskMeaning: Turn the promising A hierarchy into a coherent commercial visual master with a distinctive Airburg product identity and measurable implementation gates.
allowedActions: Read current /v2/home contracts, implementation, screenshots, and prior direction evidence
Use current first-party design references to extract commercial-grade principles without copying another brand
Create one A+ high-fidelity desktop/mobile concept and a commercial design specification
Create validation evidence and a human-review handoff
forbiddenActions: Modify app/**, components/**, lib/**, types/**, package files, deployment configuration, or production routes
Modify formulas, metric semantics, persistence, ETL, or real-data adapters
Deploy, push, redirect /home, or bind another V2 route
Set visualAccepted=true, humanAccepted=true, or COMMERCIAL_READY without explicit human review and production validation

acceptanceState.humanFeedback: Still not visually attractive enough; requires a full aesthetic rebase rather than incremental polish.

stopRule: Stop after delivering and validating the A+ commercial master concept. Do not modify production UI until the owner explicitly approves the master and authorizes a separate implementation task.
